study type: secondary analysis of a prospective study
outcome: presence of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
cohort: Women with placenta previa or low-lying placenta and at least one prior Cesarean delivery or uterine surgery, who underwent MRI assessment at a regional referral center for PAS disorders in Italy, between 2007 and 2017.
finding: MRI has excellent interobserver agreement in detecting the presence and depth of placental invasion, while agreement between the examiners is lower when assessing the topography of invasion.
